checksum_provenance: SHA256 values measured locally on unmodified captured HTTP response bodies. ETags are retained HTTP validators, not independently published checksum anchors or atlas release versions.

attribution: Allen Institute for Brain Science, Allen Mouse Brain Connectivity Atlas; Oh et al. (2014), A mesoscale connectome of the mouse brain, Nature, DOI10.1038/nature13186. This snapshot uses a later live atlas cohort, not the exact original paper sample or matrix estimator.
